name: I. Summary — offering of shares
text: I. SUMMARY The Wells Fargo Trust for Securities Lending (the “Trust”) Is offering shares of beneficial interest In the Wells Fargo Collateral Investment for Term Loans Trust Fund (the “CI Term Trust”) to qualified institutional purchasers.

name: I. Summary — establishment of Trust
text: The Trust was established pursuant to a Declaration of Trust dated October 24, 2000 and as further amended from time to time (the “Declaration of Trust”).

name: I. Summary — purpose of Trust
text: The purpose of the Trust is to provide lenders engaged In securities loan transactions (entered into through Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. as their lending agent) a continuous source of managed investment for cash collateral and for other qualified investors with investments objectives substantially similar to those for investment of securities lending cash collateral.

name: I. Summary — Maryland business trust
text: The Trust is a Maryland business trust organized under the Annotated Code of Maryland Corporations and Associations, Title 12 Business Trusts.

name: I. Summary — sole trustee
text: Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. (Wells Fargo”) currently serves as the sole trustee.

name: I. Summary — subscriber rights
text: Subscribers will become beneficial owners (“Shareholders”) of interests in the CI Term Trust, a specific Series of the Trust, and will be entitled to share in the Income and gains and losses of that Series upon acceptance of their subscriptions by Wells Fargo and payment of the consideration specified by Wells Fargo from time to time.

name: Yi. The Trustee — identity
text: Yi. THE TRUSTEE Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. is a national banking association organized under the laws of the United States with principal offices in Minneapolis, Minnesota and Columbia, Maryland and is a wholly owned subsidiary of Wells Fargo & Company.

name: Yi. The Trustee — investment manager appointment
text: Wells Fargo has appointed itself as the investment manager to manage the investments of the CI Term Trust.

name: Yi. The Trustee — retention of advisers
text: In that role, Wells Fargo may retain the services of Galliard Capital Management, Inc. (“Galliard”), Peregrine Capital Management, Inc. (“Peregrine”), Wells Capital Management ("Wells Capital”) or other direct or indirect registered investment advisory subsidiaries of Wells Fargo or its parent company to advise It on managing a portion of the CI Term Trust.

name: Yi. The Trustee — adviser ownership
text: These entities are wholly owned subsidiaries or business units of Wells Fargo or its parent company.

name: Yi. The Trustee — allocation discretion
text: The specific portion advised by any of these investment advisers will vary from time to time in the sole discretion of Wells Fargo.

name: III. Terms of the Offering — form of Shares
text: III, TERMS OF THE OFFERING The interest of each Shareholder in the CI Term Trust, a series of the Trust, will be represented by uncertificated shares of beneficial interest (the “Shares”).

name: III. Terms of the Offering — proportionate interest
text: Each Share represents an undivided proportionate interest In all assets and liabilities of the CI Term Trust and is without priority or preference over any other Share.

name: III. Terms of the Offering — initial price
text: inception of the CI Term Trust, the initial offering price per share shall be ten dollars ($10.00),

name: III. Terms of the Offering — no sales commission
text: No sales commission will be charged by the CI Term Trust with respect to any acquisition of Shares.

name: III. Terms of the Offering — offering and discontinuance
text: Wells Fargo intends to offer Shares for purchase on each Business Day (as defined in the Declaration of Trust) to investors at the then applicable value per Share (as defined below), although Wells Farge reserves the right to discontinue offering the Shares of Cl Term Trust at any time.

name: III. Terms of the Offering — minimum investment
text: The minimum required investment for initial purchases will be determined by Wells Fargo in the efficient management of the securities lending and investment program.

name: Valuation of the Trust — daily valuation
text: Valuation of the Trust The assets of the CI Term Trust will be valued each Business Day at their then current market value.

name: Valuation of the Trust — valuation services
text: Wells Fargo or its agents retained for that purpose will value the assets of the CI Term Trust and perform certain other recordkeeping and accounting services,

name: Dividends and Distribution
text: Dividends and Distribution The CI Term Trust will declare a dividend on each Business Day, and will pay such dividends monthly.

name: Expenses — Trust expenses
text: Expenses The CI Term Trust will bear all expenses incurred in connection with the acquisition, ownership and transfer of its Investments (including any transfer and withholding taxes, stamp duties, brokerage commissions and other settlement charges, and corporate actions, tax reclamation, transaction and the custodian’s out-of-pocket expenses and charges), the audit expenses of the Trust’s independent auditor associated with the CI Term Trust and any indemnification and related expenses as set forth in the Declaration of Trust,

name: Expenses — Wells Fargo and affiliate fees
text: Wells Fargo and any of its affiliates (including Investment management affiliates) may receive fees ar compensation from the CI Term Trust in amounts that are determined to be reasonable by the Trustee for investment management, custodial, accounting, administrative and transfer agent services which it or they provide to the Trust.

name: Expenses — annual fee disclosure
text: The fees, if any, charged for these services, will be disclosed to Shareholders at least annually.

name: Expenses — outside accounting services
text: Certain of the accounting services for the Trust may be provided by outside accounting services or vendors pursuant to a contract for such services entered into by Wells Fargo,

name: Expenses — vendor fee
text: For those services, the vendor may receive a fee based on the complexity of the accounting and the average daily net assets of the CI Term Trust as negotiated by Wells Fargo.

name: Expenses — affiliated brokers
text: Subject to any applicable law, Wells Fargo may on occasion use brokers and broker- dealers who are affiliates of Wells Fargo to effect transactions on behalf of the CI Term Trust.

name: Transferability of Shares and Redemption Rights — transfer prohibition
text: Transferability of Shares and Redemption Rights Shares of the CI Term Trust may not be transferred or assigned.

name: Part III — CI Term Trust Cash Redemption
text: Payment for redeerned Shares will be made in cash within seven days after the redemption date; provided, however, that Wells Fargo reserves the right to postpone payment of the redemption price (without liability for interest or income thereon) or to suspend redemption rights in certain circumstances as specified In the Declaration of Trust.

name: Part III — CI Term Trust Liability Limitation
text: Limitations of Liability and Indemnification Wells Fargo and other agents of the Trust shall have no liability to the Trust or the Shareholders for any act or omission, provided that such act or omission does not involve bad faith, willful misconduct, negligence or reckless disregard of its duties to the Trust.

name: Limitations of Liability and Indemnification — personal property
text: Shares will be deemed to be personal property, giving only the rights provided in the Declaration of Trust.

name: Limitations of Liability and Indemnification — Shareholder rights and liability
text: Under the terms of the Declaration of Trust, Shareholders will be entitled to the same {Imitation of liability extended to stockholders of a business corporation, and ownership of the Shares will not entitle the Shareholders to any title in or to the property of the Trust or the CI Term Trust or the right to call for participation or division of such property for purposes of accounting.

name: Limitations of Liability and Indemnification — Shareholder indemnity
text: In addition, the Trust will indemnify from the assets of the Trust both past and present Shareholders in the event such Shareholders are held to be personally liable for any obligation or liability of the Trust solely by reason of being or having been a Shareholder.

name: Amendment of Declaration of Trust
text: Amendment of Declaration of Trust Because the Declaration does not: confer any independent rights to Shareholders not expressly granted under Maryland law, it may be amended by the Trustee at any time without Shareholder approval, and all Shareholders purchase Shares in the Fund with notice that the Declaration of Trust may be so amended unless expressly required under the Maryland Act.

name: Conflicts of Interest — nonexclusive obligations
text: Conflicts of Interest Wells Fargo provides fiduciary, Investment advisory and management services to various accounts, some of which may invest in the same or similar types of securities as those in which the Cl Term Trust will invest. In addition, Wells Fargo or its affiliates may in the future organize other investment funds to acquire such securities. Thus, the obligations of Wells Fargo to the Trust and the CI Term Trust are not exclusive.

name: Conflicts of Interest — independent decisions
text: The investment decisions for the CI Term Trust are made independently from those other accounts managed by Wells Fargo.

name: Conflicts of Interest — differing decisions permitted
text: Wells Fargo shall be permitted to make an investment decision on behalf of the CI Term Trust which differs from decisions made for, or advice given to, such other accounts even though the investment objectives of such accounts may be the same or similar to the investment objective of the Trust or the CI Term Trust,

name: Auditors
text: Auditors KPMG LLP serves as independent auditors for the Trust and Wells Fargo and will continue in that capacity at the sole discretion of Wells Fargo.

name: IV. Performance History
text: IV. PERFORMANCE HISTORY The Collateral Investment for Term Loans Trust will commence operations on January 1, 2006. Accordingly, it has no material performance history.

name: Part V — CI Term Trust Investment Objective
text: Investment Objectives The Cl Term Trust seeks to achieve a positive return compared to the daily Fed Funds rate by investing in high-quality United States dollar-denominated securities where the prime considerations for such investments are safety of principal and daily liquidity requirements.

name: Investment Objectives — maturity and index matching
text: Subject always to the limits on portfolio maturity described below, it is anticlpated that the securities purchased for the portfolio may be matched in maturity and/or index to the maturity and/or index of the securities loans negotiated by Wells Fargo on behalf of the Subscribers.

name: Investment Objectives — stable Share price
text: The CI Term Trust will endeavor to maintain a stable $10.00 price per Share, although no assurance can be given that it will achieve its investment objective or maintain a stable Share value.

name: Investment Policies — portfolio guidelines
text: Investment Policies Investments for the CI Term Trust shall comply with the following portfolio guidelines:

name: (a) Portfolio Quality
text: (a) Portfolio Quality The CI Term Trust may only invest in U.S. dollar-denorninated obligations rated in the highest short-term rating category by one or more of the nationally recognized statistical reporting organizations (an "NRSRO”). As such, the CI Term Trust can invest in obligations that at the time of purchase (i) have received the highest short-term rating by at least one Nationally Recognized Statistical Rating Organization (NRSROs) such as “A-1” by Standard & Poor’s and “P-1” by Moody's Investors Service, Inc.; or (if) are unrated, but are determined to be of comparable quality by Wells Fargo in its role as the Investment Manager,

name: Part V(b) — CI Term Trust Permitted Investments
text: (b) Portfolio Diversification The Investment Manager is authorized to invest assets of the Fund in: U.S. Treasury and Government sponsored Agency obligations, Repurchase agreements including tri-party custodial repurchase agreements, Variable rate or issues with put features, Approved money market funds or other registered mutual funds, including those affiliated with Wells Fargo or its parent company, ~~ @ Units of business trusts or other private placement securities, including other series of the Trust, * Domestic and foreign bank obligations, and bankers’ acceptances, * Debt obligations, including commercial paper and participations, Mortgage-backed securities, Mortgage pass-through securities, Taxable municipal securities, Rule 144A securities, Asset-backed securities, and Corporate notes, bonds, debentures

name: (b) Portfolio Diversification — 5% issuer limit
text: The CI Term Trust cannot invest more than 5% of its assets at the time of purchase in obligations of any one issuer, except for obligations issued or guaranteed by the U.S. Government, its agencies and instrumentalities, registered money market funds, business trusts that are 2a-7 compliant or 2a-7-like, or repurchase agreements collateralized by the investment securities listed above.

name: (b) Portfolio Diversification — 15% illiquid limit
text: A maximum of 15% of the CI Term Trust's total assets may be invested in illiquid securities as that term Is defined in the SEC’s Rule 2a-7.

name: (b) Portfolio Diversification — private placements
text: Private placement obligations (e.g. Rule 144A Securities) will generally be considered illiquid unless at least two broker/dealers provide an active secondary market (trade date plus three business days settlement, market bid quotations).

name: (b) Portfolio Diversification — 25% industry limit
text: A maximum of 25% of the CI Term Trust may be Invested in any industry or sector, except that the financial services or banking industry may exceed 25%.

name: (b) Portfolio Diversification — additional guidelines
text: The Investment Manager will review the portfolio and may consider adopting guidelines, which could further fimlt the magnitude of the portfolio’s exposure to floating rate assets, certain indices or sectors, as it deems appropriate in its discretion.

name: (b) Portfolio Diversification — delayed application
text: The portfolio diversification requirements recited in this section will not be applied until six calendar months following the inception date of the CI Term Trust or the investment of $100 million in assets in the CI Term Trust, whichever is later.

name: {c) Portfolio Maturity — weighted average maximum
text: {c) Portfolio Maturity The maximum dollar-weighted average maturity of the CI Term Trust’s portfolio will be 190 days.

name: {c) Portfolio Maturity — shortest maturity definition
text: For purposes of determining the dollar-weighted average maturity of the CI Term Trust's portfolio, the maturity of any obligation is deemed to be the shortest of the following: ({) the stated maturity date of the obligation; (ii) the next interest rate reset for variable rate obligations; or (ili) the next put exercise date (for obligations with put features),

name: {c) Portfolio Maturity — variable rate demand obligations
text: However, for purposes of determining the maturity of a variable rate demand obligation, the maturity is deemed to be equal to the shorter of the period of time remaining until the next readjustment of the Interest rate or the period of time remaining until the principal ammount can be recovered from the issuer on demand,

name: {c) Portfolio Maturity — delayed application
text: The weighted average maturity requirement recited in this section will not be applied until six calendar months following the inception date of the Cl Term Trust or the investment of $100 million in assets in the CI Term Trust, whichever is earlier.

name: (d) Maturity of Portfolio Instruments — maximum maturity
text: (d) Maturity of Portfolio Instruments The maximum maturity of a security shall be five years.

name: (d) Maturity of Portfolio Instruments — variable and floating rates
text: For purposes of determining the maturity of variable and floating rate obligations, the shorter of the period remaining until the next adjustment of the Interest rate or the period remaining until the principal amount can be recovered through demand will be used.

name: (d) Maturity of Portfolio Instruments — weighted average life
text: For securities using a weighted average life for the maximum maturity determinant, the industry convention for these types of securities will be used.

name: (d) Maturity of Portfolio Instruments — repurchase agreement maturity
text: Repurchase agreements shail mature In one year or less.

name: (d) Maturity of Portfolio Instruments — repurchase maturity calculation
text: For purposes of determining the maturity of obligations subject to repurchase agreements, the end date of the agreement, and not the maturitles of the underlying obligation are utilized.

name: (e) Security Downgrades
text: (e) Security Downgrades of 14 In the event that a security held In the Cl Term Trust ceases to have the highest rating from the requisite NRSROs or, in the case of an Unrated Security, the Investment Manager determines that it Is no longer of comparable quality, the Investment Manager of the CI Term Trust shall reassess promptly whether such security presents minimal credit risks and shall cause the CI Term Trust to take such action as the Investment Manager determines is in the best interests of the CI Term Trust and its shareholders,

name: (F) Other Investment Companies — company securities
text: (F) Other Investment Companies The Ci Term Trust may invest in the securities of registered and unregistered investment companies to the extent permitted by law (e.g., a registered money market mutual fund subject to Rule 2a-7 of the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended, or an unregistered investment company conforming to the requirements of the SEC’s Rule 2a-7).

name: (F) Other Investment Companies — other Trust series
text: The Trustee may invest some, a significant portion, or all of the assets of the Cl Term Trust in shares of another series of the Trust (the exact proportion and amount will vary from day to day.

name: (g) Investment Restrictions — permissible index
text: (g) Investment Restrictions All variable rate obligations must be based upon a leading money market index such as:Fed Funds or LIBOR.

name: (g) Investment Restrictions — prohibited floaters
text: Dual index and inverse floaters are specifically ~*~ prohibited.

name: VI. Risk Factors — changes in value
text: VI. RISK FACTORS The value of the Shares will change with the change in value of the CI Term Trust’s investments. Many factors can affect those values,

name: VI. Risk Factors — debt security risks
text: Because the CI Term Trust Invests in debt securities, such as notes and bonds, the CI Term Trust is subject to credit risk, interest rate risk, and liquidity risk,

name: VI. Risk Factors — credit risk
text: Credit risk is the risk that the issuer or guarantor of a debt security or the counterparty to a derivative or repurchase agreement is unable or unwilling to make timely principal and/or interest payments or to otherwise honor its obligations, in which case, the value of the related debt security may decline. Debt securities are consequently subject to varying degrees of credit risk, which is often reflected in the credit rating given to a particular security.

name: VI. Risk Factors — interest rate risk
text: Interest rate risk is the risk that Interest rates may Increase, which would reduce the resale value of the securities held by the CI Term Trust (including any investments in U.S. Government obligations). Those debt securities with longer durations tend to be more sensitive to changes In interest rates, usually making them more volatile in value than securities with shorter durations, In addition, changes in market interest rates may also extend or shorten the of 14 duration of certain types of investments, such as asset-backed or mortgagebacked securities, and can affect the value and the related return on the CI Term Trust's investments. To the extent Investment by the Cl Term Trust Ina specific security may be for the purpose of matching the duration of a securities loan entered into for a Shareholder, the income earned by the Cl Term Trust on that Investment may or may not equal the amount that would have been earned had Wells Fargo selected a qualified investment with a different maturity.

name: VI. Risk Factors — liquidity risk
text: Liquidity risk may be a risk factor for the CI Term Trust when it invests in particular investments, which are difficult to purchase or sell, The Cl Term Trust’s investment in illiquid securities may reduce the returns of the CI Term Trust because it may be unable to sell the Iliguid securities at an advantageous time or price.

name: VII. Regulatory Considerations — Securities Act framework
text: VII. REGULATORY CONSIDERATIONS Securities Act of 1933 The Shares offered hereby are “securities” as defined in the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), and state securities laws. The Securities Act provides, among other things, that no sale of any securities may be made except pursuant to a registration statement, which has been-filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (“SEC”) and has become effective, unless such sale is {or the securities sold are) specifically exempted from registration, Most state securities laws have analogous provisions.

name: Securities Act of 1933 — unregistered offering
text: The offering and sale of the Shares have not been registered under the Securities Act.

name: Securities Act of 1933 — no regulatory review
text: This Memorandum has not been reviewed by the SEC, nor has the SEC or any state securities commission or regulatory authority approved, passed upon or endorsed the merits of this offering.

name: Securities Act of 1933 — private-placement exemptions
text: The offering and proposed sale of Shares described herein will be made privately to a limited number of investors (I) In reliance upon the “private placement” exemption from registration provided in Section 4(2) of the Securities Act and Rule 506 of the SEC’s Regulation D and (ii) where available, upon either appropriate exemptions from state registration or qualification requirements, or pursuant to such registration or qualification.

name: Investment Company Act of 1940 — intended exemption
text: Investment Company Act of 1940 It is intended that the CI Term Trust be exempt from the registration requirements of the 1940 Act,

name: Investment Company Act of 1940 — Section 3(c)(7) reliance
text: The CI Term Trust will rely upon, among other things, the exemption contained in Section 3(c)(7) of the 1940 Act, which exempts Issuers whose outstanding shares are beneficially owned only by investors which are “qualified purchasers;” the Issuer does not propose to make a public offering of its securities,

name: Investment Company Act of 1940 — purchaser representations
text: Wells Fargo will obtain appropriate representations and undertakings from purchasers of Shares to assure that these conditions of “beneficial ownership” are met on an ongoing basis.

name: ERISA Considerations — duties and restrictions
text: ERISA Considerations ERISA imposes certain duties and restrictions on those employee benefit plans to which It applies (“Plans”) and on those persons who are fiductaries with respect to such Plans,

name: ERISA Considerations — fiduciary review
text: Fiduciarles should review with their legal advis ors whether the purchase or halding of Shares could give rise to a transaction prohibited or not otherwise permissible under the rules and regulations of the United States Department of Labor.

name: ERISA Considerations — anticipated investors
text: It is not anticipated at this time that there will be any ERISA Plan investors in the CI Term Trust.

name: Tax Matters — partnership classification
text: Tax Matters The Trust and the CI Term Trust are classified as partnerships for Federal income tax purposes,

name: Tax Matters — transfer restrictions
text: Wells Fargo intends to restrict transfers of ownership in order to minimize the risk of the CI Term Trust being classified as a “publicly traded partnership”.

name: Tax Matters — Federal tax allocation
text: As a consequence of such status, the CI Term Trust will not itself be subject to Federal income tax but each Shareholder of the CI Term Trust will be allocated a portion of income, gain, loss and deduction, as determined according to the Declaration of Trust.

name: Tax Matters — KPMG opinion
text: Wells Fargo may request an opinion from KPMG LLP from time to time on behalf of the Trust in regard to the federal income tax consequences to Shareholders of an investment in Shares of the Trust.

name: Tax Matters — Maryland taxation
text: The CI Term Trust should be exempt from taxation by the State of Maryland and ownership of Shares in the Cl Term Trust, absent any other nexus to Maryland, should not cause a Shareholder to be subject to tax In Maryland.

name: Tax Matters — investor tax advice
text: Investors should, however, consult with their own tax advisers for advice as to the tax consequences to them of an investment in the Trust for both Federal and state Income tax purposes.

name: VIII. Additional Information — purpose
text: VIII. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION The purpose of this Memorandum is to provide an overview of the CI Term Trust and its policies.

name: VIII. Additional Information — Declaration access
text: A complete copy of the Declaration of Trust can be obtained during regular business hours from the offices of Wells Fargo at Sixth and Marquette, MAC N9305-090, Minneapolis, Minnesota 55479,

name: VIII. Additional Information — document review
text: Prospective investors are Invited to review the Declaration of Trust and any other materials available to Wells Fargo relating to the Trust, the CI Term Trust and the terms of offering.

name: VIII. Additional Information — questions
text: Representatives of Wells Fargo are available to answer any questions about the Trust and Its investment related services and can be reached at (612) 667-5187.

name: Confidentiality — reproduction and distribution prohibition
text: Any reproduction or distribution of this confidential offering memorandum, in whole or in part, or the divulgence of any of its contents without the prior written consent of Wells Fargo is prohibited.

name: Confidentiality — return of memorandum
text: By accepting this offering memorandum, the recipient agrees to return the same to Wells Fargo of 14 promptly upon delivery of updated offering materials, upon reaching a decision not to subscribe, or if such subscription is not accepted by Wells Fargo. | 7
